description: Repo-scale (c-jobqueue): enforce a scheduler's max_concurrent cap from BOTH run_next and submit_and_run_now
prompts: Add a `max_concurrent` field to Scheduler (default SCHEDULER_UNLIMITED, a new `#define SCHEDULER_UNLIMITED -1`) plus `void scheduler_set_max_concurrent(Scheduler *s, int max_concurrent)`. Add `int scheduler_submit_and_run_now(Scheduler *s, int priority, const char *payload)`: submits a job AND immediately marks it RUNNING (bypassing the normal pending queue), returning its id, or -1 if it can't run right now. The invariant: `running_count` must never exceed `max_concurrent` (when set, i.e. not SCHEDULER_UNLIMITED). This must be enforced from BOTH places that can add a running job: (1) `scheduler_run_next` (already returns 0 when it can't start a job - extend the condition to also cover the cap), and (2) `scheduler_submit_and_run_now` - both must refuse to start a new job when at capacity.
name: add_c_jobqueue_max_concurrent_cap
